name: song_joint28_continuous_replay_descriptive_v1
model: tracked S01+S02 source-only factorized Song 28-state JSON bundle; no refit
stream: entire raw 250 Hz 8-channel EMG plus recorded 112 Hz six-axis IMU, causal filter, 50 EMG samples, 25 sample hop, final 22 IMU samples at or before window end after IMU watermark
event_rule: existing live worker: top joint class at probability >= 0.15 for three consecutive emitted frames; no target tuning
scored_formal_interval: valid completed formal trial stable_start_sample <= full 50-sample EMG window < stable_end_sample; native 28-class cue label
scored_rest_interval: valid completed calibration_rest_initial or calibration_rest_final stable interval; report non-neutral hand predictions and displayed states only
unlabelled_frames: count and preserve predictions, but exclude from accuracy and false-positive denominators
endpoints: rest-block active-hand argmax and displayed fractions
frame loss and state transition counts
limitations: one person/day, cue labels not physiological onset, S03 readiness failed and S04 previously inspected, HDF5 packet-batch alignment not a hardware timing oracle, no real-time or cross-day/person claim
